Rishi — thanks for the clear summary. Procurement can approve an "invoice-only" exception for pilot engagements under $25,000 and up to 90 days provided the vendor submits the following before the first invoice: 

- Completed W9 (received)
- Bank letter for ACH enrollment (required)
- High-level security evidence: SOC2 summary or equivalent (required)
- Signed one-page SOW or simple MSA referencing pilot scope (preferred)

Please ask CloudArc to upload the bank letter and SOC2 summary. I've attached our Procurement_Onboarding_Checklist.docx to this thread — I'll tick the boxes once docs are in. Once all evidence is received, finance can create a temporary PO identifier for internal tracking; legal (Vivek) should review the SOW if there's nonstandard terms.

Procurement will not approve open-ended, invoice-only arrangements beyond the pilot window. After pilot completion, vendor should be moved to standard PO flow or an approved vendor record created.

- Monica
